reason: I want this for my mom and my son, and the live video and GPS would give me some peace of mind. But another $19.99 a month on top of everything else, plus $249 up front, is a lot when I already pay for care and gas for the two-hour drive. I would not buy it on an ad. I would go read the support groups first.
objection: The monthly fee never ends, and I can't tell whether the video and GPS will actually work where he wanders, or whether the SOS alert will reach me in time.
would_change_my_mind: Other caregivers in my Facebook groups and Reddit threads reporting that it works reliably for a wanderer, plus a month-to-month option where I can cancel the plan at any time.
